description:
Visualize your radio frequency (RF) spectrum

Chanalyzer unlocks the full potential of your Wi-Spy or WiPry Clarity spectrum analyzer. Dial in spectrum analysis settings to see every detail. Detect and locate sources of Wi-Fi and non-Wi-Fi interference. Optimize your Wi-Fi and monitor your 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz networks in real time. Identify congestion and channel saturation. Record spectrum data for later analysis. Tag interference events with notes and images. Report on your findings with easy-to-use templates and content blocks.
In This Release
- Add support for MetaGeek Plus network Snapshots
- Add GPS/GNSS Latitude/Longitude to Snapshots and user-created transmitter classifier signatures
- Add Bluetooth and Bluetooth LE channel frequency labels
- Adds a 6GHz Overview block for Report Builder
- Fix an issue with License Activation on machines with ARM64 CPUs
- Improve sweep processing to avoid stuttering in waterfall
- Fixes the Channels Table counting APs from the wrong band
- Improves support for hot-plugging devices
Known Issues
- Channels Table over-counts MLO-enabled APs
- Hot-unplugging a device does not hide the spectrum views
- Hot-plug with multiple devices is unreliable--multi-device works fine if connected at app startup
